text:
Asha M.: Quick sync — we want to publish the release announcement for the batching + prefix-KV improvements tomorrow at 10:00 PT. Need final changelog, docs link, and staged rollout plan from eng. Can we lock this timeline?
Ben K.: Changelog PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/428 — main points: API param name tweak, default batching config change, perf numbers added. Waiting for review.
Sophie L.: Docs PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/212 — includes code samples and a new 'batching' guide. I can merge once API names are confirmed.
Ramesh P.: Marketing needs a 2–3 sentence bench takeaway and the exact PR links for the blog + tweet. Also need the embargo window (if any).
Jules R.: Rollout proposal: staged rollout starting 10:00 PT: canary 5% for 30m, ramp to 25% over next 2h, 100% after 6h if no regressions. Regions: start US/EU, APAC next day during low traffic. Fallback: auto-disable if error rate >0.5% or latency p95 increases 30%.
Ben K.: Confirming feature flag name: feature.ff_adaptive_batching_v1. Canary route and fallback hooks in place. I will attach a small changelog snippet here.
Ben K.: Changelog snippet: "Adaptive batching and prefix KV caching — reduced per-token costs by ~25% for typical chat sessions; improved p95 latency by ~40ms on 4k contexts. API: batching.mode renamed to batching.strategy (backwards-compatible alias)."
Sophie L.: I'll pin the docs link and add the cURL example. Example snippet:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-batched-v1","prompt":"Hello"}'
```
Ramesh P.: Webinar on the launch — can we do a short demo at 11:00 PT same day? 20m demo + 25m Q&A. Need a registration link to include in the post.
Asha M.: Yes — webinar scheduled for 11:00 PT. Ramesh, I'll send you the sign-up link by EOD. Marketing will craft the bench narrative once Ben posts final numbers.
Ben K.: Final bench numbers: average token cost down ~25%, p50 latency ~ -12ms, p95 latency ~ -40ms on our reference workload (chat, 4k context). I'll drop the raw CSV in the PR.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: canary rollout starts 2026-03-22T10:00:00-07:00 (canary 5% / 30m). Track at https://deploys.redwood.ai/12345
Jules R.: QA note — we'll monitor model outputs for quality regressions and have a rollback plan ready. Also coordinating docs-first feature flag so docs and API match on go-live.
Sophie L.: Merged docs PR and added an explicit migration note for batching.strategy. Docs live at https://docs.redwood.ai/reference/batching (will update blog links after final merge).
Asha M.: Final checklist: changelog PR merged, docs PR merged, bench blurb confirmed, deploy scheduled, webinar page live. If all green, publish announcement at 10:00 PT and webinar promo after release goes live. Please react with :thumbsup: when you confirm.
Ben K.: :thumbsup:
